caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a side chair made of walnut from mid-18th century Philadelphia, presented on a beige or light brown background. The image is composed of three primary black ink line drawings labeled as “Plan of Seat,” “Front elevation,” and “Side elevation.” The "Plan of Seat" is a top-down view of the chair seat, showing a trapezoidal shape with rounded edges and two projecting back corners. The "Front elevation" displays the ornate design of the chair's backrest, which features a central carved element with scroll shapes and a fan motif at the top, as well as cabriole legs with shell carvings at the knees and carved feet. The "Side elevation" shows the chair in profile, depicting the curve of the backrest, the profile of the seat, and the same decorative leg details. The annotations include the words "Side Chair walnut Mid. 18th century Phila.," “Scale 3/8” = 1’,” and the name "Bernard Krieger" in the bottom right corner. The overall composition is line-based with no shading, and the drawing includes precise measurements and annotations in cursive and script handwriting. There are faint reddish smudges in the lower part of the drawing, particularly near the legs of the chair in the front elevation.
title: Side Chair
